cause: The initial Context Pack legitimately includes backend/workbench/figure_context.py, but FMS rescope rejects backend paths with fewer than four path segments. Retaining that frozen path while adding the required Draft/schema integration paths is therefore impossible.

impact: The current formal line cannot safely expand to the Draft/schema integration paths. Existing in-scope core work continues; the integration slice requires a new dependent line from a clean checkpoint.

cause: MemoryCandidate has no typed apply_mode, vocabulary, verifier, or validation fields, so approved memory cannot safely control a default's applicability.
impact: The new validity test fails before production changes, proving suggest_default cannot yet be made fail-closed.
lesson: Persist the typed memory metadata before adding a runtime path that can alter proposal defaults.

cause: The new retrieval test used the old synthetic source hash while binding a newly generated redacted summary snapshot. The existing source-integrity guard correctly omitted the memory.

evidence.ref: build_redacted_summary_snapshot returned 1d2dcfba... while the candidate fixture declared aaaaaaaa...

impact: The first green attempt could not reach the typed validity assertions; no production behavior was weakened or bypassed.
lesson: A retrieval fixture must use the exact snapshot reference and hash returned by its source binding, not a syntactic placeholder digest.

cause: Typed content/candidate metadata now carries apply_mode, vocabulary version, verifier window, validation time, and expiry through explicit approval into retrieval.
impact: suggest_default is active only with a matching vocabulary and current verifier; stale state downgrades to inform_only and mismatched or expired state is omitted. Existing v1 records remain readable as inform_only.
lesson: Versioned memory content must preserve legacy hashes while making newer default-changing behavior fail closed.

cause: The browser rerun patch id used only the source context and changed field names, so changing the same model field to a second value collided with an earlier idempotency record.

evidence.ref: Graph rerun from logit to GLM - binomial returned PATCH_ID_CONFLICT; the first attempt produced a failed run.

impact: A valid model-family switch could not be retried from the same source node after a different value had already used the old patch id.
lesson: Manual rerun idempotency keys must include the exact normalized edit, not only the edited field names.

cause: The exact-edit patch id fix was verified by focused frontend tests and a visible Workbench rerun from Logit to GLM - binomial.

evidence.ref: Frontend manualRerunPatch and OperationSection tests: 14 passed; Workbench Graph showed completed glm (primary) and Result after a visible Logit -> GLM - binomial rerun.

impact: Model-family switches can now be retried with distinct exact edits while preserving idempotency for identical requests.
lesson: Browser acceptance must exercise repeated edits to the same source field, not only a single happy-path model switch.

cause: A transient provider response status (503) failed immediately instead of receiving one bounded retry before the Notebook planning attempt was classified as unavailable.

evidence.ref: TDD red: transient status 503 attempted once; after the fix the targeted retry test and the provider test module pass.

impact: Transient DeepSeek or compatible-provider interruptions could turn a recoverable Notebook planning request into a terminal failure without a second attempt.
lesson: Retry only status-classified transient upstream failures before any public activity is emitted; never retry authentication, request, or partial-content failures.

cause: The adapter now retries one transient upstream status before failing and preserves fail-closed behavior for non-transient or partially emitted requests.

evidence.ref: tests/test_llm_providers.py: 109 passed; targeted transient retry, partial activity, private reasoning, and non-object tool tests: 4 passed.

impact: Recoverable provider interruptions have a bounded recovery path without widening retry behavior or exposing upstream bodies.
lesson: Provider resilience evidence must cover transient status, partial activity, private reasoning, and malformed tool output separately.

cause: After restarting the non-reloading backend from the v1.8.5 worktree, the real DeepSeek Notebook planner completed and persisted three typed options without the prior unsupported artifact vocabulary failure.

evidence.ref: in-app browser tab_e2e Notebook nb_09cf1b6854284f61859c60b16cbdf0bb: planning completed; current option batch persisted logit_1, ols_1, and probit_1 with fresh/valid status

impact: The real provider path now has visible success evidence for bounded context compilation, typed option validation, native artifact vocabulary, and persisted Notebook options; no execution was triggered automatically.
lesson: When a browser stays connected to a non-reloading backend, restart the exact service before judging a code fix; preserve the browser tab and re-run the same bounded acceptance.

cause: The adapter now distinguishes private provider activity from public text and partial tool-call progress, allowing one retry only when private reasoning was the sole progress before stream termination.

evidence.ref: tests/test_llm_providers.py tests/test_notebook_routes.py tests/test_notebook_planning_agent.py: 212 passed, 1 skipped; private-reasoning recovery and partial-tool no-replay targeted tests passed

impact: A DeepSeek-style hidden-reasoning disconnect has a bounded recovery path, while public output and partial typed calls remain fail-closed and are never replayed.
lesson: Provider retries must classify hidden activity separately from public or typed progress; otherwise reliability and duplicate-request safety conflict.

cause: Notebook typed submissions previously required the provider to reproduce the server-owned dataset source pin, genesis preconditions, and native artifact ids exactly. That created avoidable correction turns and surfaced provider guesses as contract failures.
impact: Dataset-rooted source pins and native capability artifact contracts are now derived once from server context and published vocabulary. Model fields, evidence refs, and unknown typed fields remain strict; no new execution surface was opened.
lesson: Provider-facing descriptions are advisory; executable envelope identity and native output identity must be canonicalized by the server before validation.

cause: The non-reloading backend had to be restarted before the browser could exercise the current Notebook planner implementation.

evidence.ref: in-app browser tab 4 Notebook nb_09cf1b6854284f61859c60b16cbdf0bb: Update goal and replan completed with 3 fresh valid persisted options logit_1, ols_1, probit_1; no planning alert

impact: The real provider path remains usable after the server-owned source and artifact envelope change; the browser-visible Notebook did not expose the historical source-pin or artifact-vocabulary errors.
lesson: A browser acceptance result must be taken after the exact non-reloading backend is restarted; otherwise it proves only the previous process state.

cause: The Notebook planner now admits executable model families from the shared family contracts, publishes each family's artifact vocabulary and explicit model-options policy, and canonicalizes unsupported legacy covariance fields only for families that publish no options contract.

evidence.ref: targeted model-family contract tests and in-app browser Notebook nb_983ff05869eb4d81998f197aaf95c430: plan produced glm:binomial, negative_binomial, and ols; confirmed GLM Draft validated and executed as run b5feba03 with glm_1 result

impact: New source-rooted Notebook planning no longer depends on model-name-specific artifact guesses for these families; unsupported OLS option leakage is removed without weakening strict validation of unknown business fields.
lesson: Executable Notebook capabilities need one shared admission projection containing family identity, option vocabulary, and primary artifact vocabulary; browser evidence must exercise the resulting Draft and run, not only the registry unit tests.

cause: Provider-generated Notebook envelopes could disagree with the server-owned source pin, nested model family, model-options policy, or artifact vocabulary and consume correction turns or surface false contract failures.

evidence.ref: 144 focused tests passed; one real DeepSeek Notebook replan produced 3 fresh valid current options; approved project memory was retrieved

impact: Server normalization now binds dataset source and nested model family, removes only unsupported legacy option fields, and derives native artifact ids from published vocabulary. Unknown business fields and invalid provenance remain strict. The browser path completed without NOTEBOOK, MODEL_OPTIONS, or ARTIFACT_REQUIRED errors.
lesson: Treat provider output as an advisory proposal: canonicalize server-owned identity and published output vocabulary once before strict model-family validation, then test the real browser provider path.

cause: The v1.8.5 model-family and Notebook contract scope is complete on the final local tree, including registry admission, server-owned envelope normalization, real provider browser evidence, and the declared regression and gate evidence.

evidence.ref: commit 6bae383; backend 4396 passed/8 skipped/1 xfailed; golden 23; frontend 172 files/1541 tests; tsc clean; Notebook browser replan passed

impact: The declared v1.8.5 model-family scope is complete without opening arbitrary execution or weakening strict user/model field validation. External provider availability and out-of-scope ML/quant work remain explicit boundaries.
lesson: Close a model-family development line only after the registry contract, real browser path, and final local verification evidence agree on the same tree.

cause: Fresh Notebook contract regression review found two shared-boundary defects: custom capabilities were not always pinned to the uploaded dataset, and rerun with a model lacking editable model_options returned a generic no-capability message.

evidence.ref: 75 focused Notebook planning/route tests passed; TDD red evidence recorded before the fix.

impact: Valid custom dataset-rooted proposals could be rejected later, and users could not distinguish an unsupported rerun model from an empty server capability registry.
lesson: Normalize server-owned dataset pins for every dataset-rooted Notebook operation and explain capability admission failures at the operation boundary.
